{{Quote|Half-Moonsing is a Jedi of great insight, regardless of his station.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="TJP" />}}
'''Half-Moonsing''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Temple employee|caretaker]] of the speeder pool at the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in the finals years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. While he failed to pass the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]], Half-Moonsing was permitted to stay in the Temple while maintaining the title of Jedi.

==Biography==
Brought to the Temple at a very young age, Half-Moonsing graduated from the [[Jedi academy]] and was selected by a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] for training as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. Accompanying his master for years, Half-Moonsing was recommended for the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and returned to Coruscant to undergo the tests. Despite his training however, Half-Moonsing failed the Trials and was not permitted to continue along the Jedi Path. However, Half-Moonsing decided to stay at the Temple, taking up a post in the docking complex, specifically the speeder pool. As of about [[115 BBY]], Half-Moonsing had become the caretaker of the speeder pool, overseeing all of the Temple's speeder craft and ensuring they were checked out properly. Half-Moonsing was noted for his deep insight and being a helpful part of the Temple staff, remaining in his post until he passed away sometime between [[72 BBY/Legends|72]] and [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="TJP" />

==Behind the scenes==
While it did not make it into the finished edition, [[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]], author of [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']], revealed that he believed Half-Moonsing to be a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]].<ref name="TJPEN" />
